selection.constraint: Tune Interest-Macro Recall@10 must be at least Global and within 0.2 percentage points of the best checkpoint; Tune User-Macro Recall@10 must be at least Balanced Ridge alpha=10 beta=0.5
selection.objective: maximize Tune Interest-Macro NDCG@10 on the Interest-Macro Pareto frontier
selection.tie_break: higher Interest Recall, higher User Recall, smaller beta, smaller L2, temperature nearer 1, smaller learning rate, fewer epochs
